title: Buying a Northloop Protect Plan: Conditions of Purchase and the Plan Price
content:
**Conditions of purchase.** A plan under the Northloop Protect Plans may be bought only for an item whose category is in the plan's eligible categories, whose condition is eligible, whose unit price lies between the minimum and maximum eligible price, and only within the purchase window counted in calendar days from the item's order date. The plan price is the price of the item's price band in the plan price ladder, charged once at purchase.

## The conditions one by one

| Condition | What is read | Met when |
|---|---|---|
| Category | The category of the item to be covered | The category is one of the plan's eligible item categories |
| Condition | The condition of the item to be covered (new, renewed or otherwise) | The condition is one of the plan's eligible item conditions |
| Price | The unit price of the item to be covered | The unit price lies between the plan's lowest and highest eligible item price |
| Timing | The order date of the item and the date the plan is bought | The plan is bought within the plan's purchase window, counted in calendar days from the item's order date; on every plan that window is 30 calendar days |

All four conditions must hold; a plan is bought only when each of them is met.

## The plan price

- **Which figure:** the plan price is the figure the plan's price ladder shows for the price band into which the covered item's unit price falls.
- **When charged:** once, at purchase. The plan price is not charged in instalments and is not charged again later in the term.

## Hypothetical illustrations

**A purchase that meets every condition.** An item in an eligible category, in new condition, with a unit price of 249.00 USD inside the plan's eligible range, is ordered on 2026-05-01, and the plan is bought on 2026-05-20, 19 calendar days after the order date. Every condition is met. The plan price is the plan's ladder figure for the 200.00 to 499.99 band, charged once on 2026-05-20.

**A purchase outside the window.** The same item, with the plan sought on 2026-06-25, 55 calendar days after the order date, is outside a 30-day purchase window; the timing condition is not met.

**A purchase failing on one condition only.** An item in an eligible category and condition, ordered three days ago, whose unit price is above the plan's highest eligible item price, fails the price condition; the other conditions being met does not make the plan purchasable.
